commands.decode_cold_server: serve CHECKPOINT --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8099 --context 65552 --parallel 1 --no-drafts --prompt-cache-gib 0 --no-thinking (plain decode and cold prompts); the DSpark decode column used the concurrency server below without --no-drafts, on port 8099
commands.decode: python3 tools/bench_openai.py http://127.0.0.1:8099/v1 local-model --tokens 256 --reps 3 --temperatures 0 --label LABEL --output FILE
commands.concurrency: python3 tools/bench_concurrent.py http://127.0.0.1:8122/v1 m --levels 1,4 --tokens 256 --reps 3 --temperatures 0 --label LABEL --output FILE [--alone --serial]
commands.cold: python3 cold_prefill.py http://127.0.0.1:8099/v1 --model m --ck CHECKPOINT --sizes 2048,8192,32768,65536 --label LABEL --output FILE
commands.depth: python3 decode_depth.py http://127.0.0.1:PORT/v1 --model m (default_model for MLX) --ck CHECKPOINT --sizes 2048,8192,32768,65536 --tokens 192 --rep0 REP0 --label LABEL --output FILE; native servers as decode_cold_server; the 65,344 and 65,536 rows used --sizes 65344:192,65536:16
